answer: A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the lantern ordering is published with the forge batch, the prism audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 47% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 479 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
